fallback.title: Fallback Settings
fallback.subtitle: Ordered fallback chain · Provider / Model · Enable/Disable · Reorder — no secrets exposed
fallback.helpDesc: When primary LLM call fails (timeout, quota, 5xx), the runtime tries the chain in order. Only enabled entries are tried. Provider must be one of 6 types; model is optional override.
fallback.helpChain: Chain order = priority. Top is tried first. Use ↑/↓ to reorder.
fallback.helpModel: Fallback Model: optional default model name used when the failed call has no model (e.g. qwen2.5, gpt-4o-mini). Leave empty to keep provider's default model.
fallback.helpNote: Config is stored in admin_settings (DB) and OAOS_LLM_FALLBACK_JSON / OAOS_FALLBACK_PROVIDERS (OAOS LLM Runtime only). Never contains API keys. Not written as Hermes Runtime config when Hermes owns routing — Hermes config is authoritative.
fallback.enabledDesc: When off, no fallback is attempted — failures return immediately.
fallback.chainDesc: Add providers below. Drag or use arrows to reorder. Toggle enabled per entry.
fallback.fallbackModelHelp: Used when model is empty on an entry and no model was set on the original call.
fallback.emptyChain: No fallback entries — add one above. Requests will not fallback.
fallback.l5Only: Only L5 can modify fallback settings.
fallback.hermesBannerTitle: Hermes Runtime owns LLM routing — OAOS Fallback disabled
fallback.hermesBannerDesc: This server runs Hermes Runtime (authoritative). OAOS LLM Fallback chain is OAOS LLM Runtime only and is not presented or written as Hermes Runtime config. Switch to LLM Runtime to configure fallback.
fallback.hermesBannerDetail: Ownership gate: runtime_mode=hermes → 409 HERMES_MODE_NOOP on /v1/llm/fallback. Mirroring to HERMES_CONFIG_PATH is deprecated and requires runtime_mode=llm + OAOS_ALLOW_HERMES_CONFIG_WRITE=1.
fallback.hermesBannerAction: Change mode in Providers → Runtime Mode (L5 only)

environment.default: Open Operations Health, click Refresh, and confirm that the database and Control Plane show Healthy. Return here and click Check again.

runtime.default: Open ACP settings and click Test connection. If it fails, correct the Hermes URL or credentials, click Save, and test again.
runtime.REQUIRED_MISSING: Open ACP settings, enable ACP, enter the Hermes base URL, click Save, and then click Test connection.
runtime.NOT_APPLIED: Have an operator apply the saved values to the service environment and restart it through the approved procedure. Then open ACP settings, click Test connection, and return here to Check again. The console will not restart services.

ingress.default: Open Connections, open the configured Mattermost or Slack connection, and click Test connection. Correct the settings and Save before testing again if needed.
ingress.REQUIRED_MISSING: Open Connections, choose Mattermost or Slack, enter the required URL and credentials, click Save, and then click Test connection.
ingress.NOT_APPLIED: Have an operator apply the saved connection values and restart the affected service through the approved procedure. Then open that connection and click Test connection. The console will not restart services.

policy.default: Sign in as an L5 administrator. On Policy, open Draft, correct the rules, click Validate, Save Draft (L5), Approve (L5), and Publish (L5).
policy.L5_ADMIN_MISSING: Ask an existing L5 administrator to sign in or create an L5 administrator under Management > Users. Policy approval and publishing require L5.
policy.ACTIVE_POLICY_MISSING: As an L5 administrator, open Policy > Draft, save and Validate the draft, click Approve (L5), then Publish (L5) and complete the confirmation. OAOS will not publish a policy automatically.
policy.POLICY_INVALID: As an L5 administrator, open Policy > Draft, fix every validation error, click Validate, Save Draft (L5), Approve (L5), and Publish (L5).

mcp.default: Open MCP settings, select the server, complete its command or URL settings, Save, and click Test connection.

knowledge.default: Open Knowledge Operations to identify the configured connector. For Notion, open Connections > Notion; for Outline, open Knowledge > Outline. Click Test connection for that source, then return here and click Check again.

notifications.default: Open Connections, open the configured Slack or SMTP destination, click Save, and then click Test connection.

verify.default: Open each earlier stage marked Needs attention, complete its listed action, and then return to Final verification and click Check again.
